'''Marg Sar''' was a member of [[Lema Xandret]]'s colony on [[Sebaddon]] who served on the crew of the ''[[Cinzia]]'' alongside [[Kenev]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Marg and Kenev encountered a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]], and blew up their ship, and themselves, in order to the ship's cargo a secret.
